# DevHubConnect

> DevHubConnect is an AI-powered n8n workflow marketplace and studio. Users browse, purchase, and customize n8n automation workflows using Claude AI.

## What DevHubConnect Does

DevHubConnect helps developers and automation engineers build production-ready n8n workflows faster. The platform combines a curated template marketplace with an AI studio powered by Claude (`claude-sonnet-4-6`) to generate, customize, and download importable n8n workflow JSON.

## Core Features

### Template Marketplace
- 500+ ready-to-import n8n workflow JSON templates
- Categories: CRM, email, Slack, Google Sheets, Airtable, HTTP, database, AI/LLM, e-commerce, DevOps
- Each template downloads as a complete, importable `.json` file for n8n

### Workflow Studio (AI-Powered)
The Studio has three modes, all powered by Claude AI:

1. **Customize** — Upload a DevHubConnect template and describe changes in plain English. Claude returns the complete modified workflow JSON ready to import into n8n.
2. **Build New** — Describe any automation in plain English. Claude generates a full n8n workflow from scratch with correct node types, connections, and parameters.
3. **Prompt Store** — Purchase expert system prompts trained specifically on n8n workflow patterns. Use them inside the Studio for domain-specific workflow generation (email triage, Slack alerts, data sync, etc.).

### JSON + Prompt Combos
A combo product includes a starter workflow JSON and a purchased system prompt. The JSON is immediately downloadable; the prompt unlocks inside the Studio for AI-assisted customization.

## Tech Stack
- Frontend: React + TypeScript + Vite + Tailwind CSS
- Backend: Node.js + Express
- AI: Anthropic Claude (`claude-sonnet-4-6`)
- Auth: GitHub OAuth
- Payments: Stripe
- Database: PostgreSQL

## Use Cases DevHubConnect Solves
- "I need an n8n workflow that sends a Slack message when a new row is added to Google Sheets"
- "Build me an n8n automation that monitors a Gmail inbox and routes emails by sender domain"
- "Customize this webhook workflow to add error handling and a retry loop"
- "Generate an n8n workflow that syncs new Stripe customers to Airtable"

## Pricing
- Individual n8n templates: one-time purchase ($5–$25)
- JSON + Prompt combos: one-time purchase ($15–$49)
- All purchases permanent — no subscription required
